description: Extract the people from a LinkedIn Sales Navigator search URL, with their titles, companies and (by default) verified work emails. Use this when the user has a Sales Navigator search they want as a list.

account.description: Connected account email to run the search with.

max.description: Upper bound on records. Drives the credit hold; unused credits are refunded. Defaults to 100.

url.description: The search URL, copied from the platform after building the filters.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the job before returning its id instead (default 120).

with_emails.description: Also find work email addresses. Defaults to true.

name: scrupp_export_sales_navigator_search
title: Export a Sales Navigator search
